release.web_exception_rule: Responsive geometry may adapt to viewport constraints, but product behavior, information hierarchy, copy, state transitions, interaction semantics, accessibility, localization and supported features must remain equivalent. Every intentional difference requires a parity-matrix exception.

default.loading: Show a BLab loading or skeleton state and prevent duplicate destructive submission.
default.empty: Show a localized empty state with the next useful action.
default.error: Show a localized retryable error state and preserve safe navigation.
default.unauthorized: Redirect to the locale-preserving sign-in route with a validated next path.
default.consent: Request explicit consent before provider, AI, notification or device-capability work.
default.quota: Show the quota outcome and disable only the gated action; never expose Web billing.
default.offline: Declare the online-core boundary, preserve only proven local drafts, and offer retry.

auth.loading: Disable the submitted auth action and expose progress without losing field values.
auth.empty: Render the empty form state with required labels and localized guidance.
auth.error: Render field or form authentication errors with resend and recovery actions where applicable.
auth.unauthorized: Keep the user on the auth route and render no consumer data.
auth.consent: No native terms/privacy consent action is present; model email verification as the separate verification-outcome action.
auth.quota: Not applicable; do not invent a quota or subscription gate.
auth.offline: Keep entered values, explain network failure, and allow a safe retry.

onboarding.loading: Show onboarding initialization progress without skipping the current page.
onboarding.empty: Not applicable; onboarding always has an explicit page or completion state.
onboarding.error: Show persistence failure and allow retry without marking onboarding complete.
onboarding.unauthorized: Return to locale-preserving sign-in before persisting user-scoped policy.
onboarding.consent: Not applicable; native onboarding pages do not collect age-policy or product consent.
onboarding.offline: Do not claim completion until the required user-scoped persistence succeeds.

browser-equivalent.loading: Show permission or upload progress and keep the browser action cancellable.
browser-equivalent.empty: Explain that no browser capability or input has been selected and offer the fallback.
browser-equivalent.error: Show the browser/API failure with a file, clipboard, download or retry fallback.
browser-equivalent.unauthorized: Require authenticated user scope before reading or writing consumer data.
browser-equivalent.consent: Request browser permission or explicit user consent before device/API access.
browser-equivalent.quota: Show provider or feature quota and keep billing disabled on Web.
browser-equivalent.offline: Do not claim background or device delivery; surface the online-core limitation.

native-only.loading: Not applicable to Web; show an explicit unavailable capability state.
native-only.empty: Not applicable to Web; explain that no browser equivalent is promised.
native-only.error: Record the native-only boundary and link to the supported Web alternative if one exists.
native-only.unauthorized: Not applicable; no native capability is exposed from Web.
native-only.consent: Do not request a misleading Web permission for an unavailable native capability.
native-only.offline: Not applicable; native-only capability is not part of Web online-core.

disabled.loading: Not applicable; the disabled capability must not start work.
disabled.empty: Show the feature as unavailable rather than an empty purchasable catalog.
disabled.error: Explain the disabled product policy without exposing provider details.
disabled.consent: Do not request consent for a disabled capability.
disabled.quota: Do not expose quota, upgrade, purchase or restore controls on Web.

audit_notes: The Flutter source and BLab public contract are authoritative for supported product behavior.
The Web route status records the current repository state on version/web/1.1.0; planned entries are not claims of implementation.
Native-only capability rows are explicit boundaries and must remain visible in release evidence.
No stale PRD statement can promote a route, feature or subscription capability to parity without source and evidence ownership.
